advisory.heading: When you write a sentence
advisory.text: Before you change a file of the round, run the report form of the check script once for each file in the round list.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md, line 154 writes "once", but line 235 writes "one time" for the same type of step: run the report form of the check script.
advisory.correction: "Before you change a file of the round, run the report form of the check script one time for each file in the round list."

advisory.heading: When you write a sentence
advisory.text: Run each selected manual check 1 time
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md, line 329 writes "1 time", but lines 235 and 330 write "one time" for the same type of step: do an action a number of times.
advisory.correction: "Run each selected manual check one time"

advisory.heading: When you write a sentence
advisory.text: Write each new or changed rule that no tested quote is from in the end-of-run report.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 217, the phrase "that no tested quote is from in the end-of-run report" can also tell the reader that the tested quotes are in the end-of-run report.
advisory.correction: "In the end-of-run report, write each new or changed rule that has no tested quote."

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 161, the noun "tie-break" is not in the glossary or in the base list.
advisory.correction: "This item does not rank the rules."

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: Give their identifiers to the runner of the project
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 327, the noun "runner" is not in the glossary or in the base list, and the text does not tell which script or command it is.
advisory.correction: "Give their identifiers to the test script of the project"

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: Save the screen text to the screen-text file in the round folder.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md lines 356 and 360, the noun "screen-text file" is not in the glossary or in the base list, and the file does not give its name.
advisory.correction: "Save the screen text to the file `screen-text.txt` in the round folder."

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: When a reviewer gives a finding, correct your text, or reject the finding as `references/review.md` tells you.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 433, the pointer identifies review.md, the file that contains it, and repeats item 4 of "During and after a review round" at line 156 without the place in the file.
advisory.correction: When a reviewer gives a finding, correct your text, or reject the finding as item 4 of "During and after a review round" tells you.
